metadata.name: ww-image
metadata.description: An image element with customizable sizing, overlays, filters, and lazy loading support.
features: Optional crop mode: shows only a crop box of the image (ratio + focus point + zoom), fitted in (or covering) the element, without a new image URL

properties.name: url
properties.description: Image source URL. Urls from the project images should be formatted as `designs/<projectId>/sections/<file_name>?_wwcv=<number>`. Respect the exact url returned by the project images search, even if it does not contain an http prefix.

properties.name: objectFit
properties.description: How the image should fit its container (bindable). Use cover by default to prevent stretching. In crop mode: cover makes the crop cover the element, anything else fits it inside.

properties.name: overlay
properties.description: CSS color or gradient overlay on the image

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Alternative text for accessibility. Supports multiple languages.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Intrinsic width of the image in px (layout hint). In crop mode, the original's width: used for the image ratio and the zoom cap (else read from the loaded image).

properties.name: height
properties.description: Intrinsic height of the image in px. In crop mode, the original's height.

properties.name: crop
properties.description: Crop mode: show only a crop box of the image — the largest box of cropRatio, divided by cropZoom, as centred on (cropFocusX, cropFocusY) as the image allows (imgproxy fp gravity rule). No new image URL: the image is placed and clipped in CSS.

properties.name: cropRatio
properties.description: crop on: width:height of the crop, "4:5" or a number. Empty = the image's own ratio.

properties.name: cropFocusX
properties.description: crop on: horizontal centre of the crop, 0–1. Empty = 0.5.

properties.name: cropFocusY
properties.description: crop on: vertical centre of the crop, 0–1. Empty = 0.5.

properties.name: cropZoom
properties.description: crop on: zoom, 1 or more (the crop box is the largest box of the ratio divided by it). Capped by the minimum output size and a hard cap of 8.

properties.name: cropMinOutputWidth
properties.description: crop on: caps the zoom so the crop keeps at least this many source pixels of width (needs width / height = the original's size). 0 = not checked.

properties.name: cropMinOutputHeight
properties.description: crop on: same for the height. 0 = not checked.

specifications: Use valid Unsplash URLs for image sources when needed
Optimize image dimensions to 2000x2000px or smaller
Set objectFit to cover by default to prevent stretched images
Alt text should always be provided for accessibility
Crop mode needs the original's size (width / height) when the URL is a resized version, otherwise the zoom cap is computed on the small image.
Crop mode: an element without a height of its own takes the crop's shape (aspect-ratio at zero specificity); with a height, the crop is fitted inside it (contain) or covers it (objectFit = cover).
